title: USNI News Fleet and Marine Tracker: Aug. 31, 2026
total: These are the approximate positions of the U.S. Navy’s deployed carrier strike groups and amphibious ready groups throughout the world as of Aug. 31, 2026, based on Navy and public data. In cases in which a CSG or ARG is conducting disaggregated operations, the chart reflects the location of the capital ship.

properties.name: In Japan
properties.said: USS Tripoli (LHA-7) is in port in Sasebo, Japan.

properties.name: In the Caribbean
properties.said: Littoral combat ship USS Billings (LCS-15) is operating in the Central Caribbean Sea. The Freedom-class LCS is based at Naval Station Mayport, Fla. The 24th MEU is operating in the region as Littoral Combat Force 24 and is spread throughout the region, including aboard USS San Antonio (LPD-17) in the Southern Pacific.

properties.name: In the Western Atlantic
properties.said:
Aircraft carrier USS Dwight D. Eisenhower (CVN-69) is underway conducting routine operations in the Western Atlantic . Amphibious assault ship USS Kearsarge (LHD-3) departed last Monday from Norfolk, according to ship spotters.

In addition to these major formations, not shown are others serving in submarines, individual surface ships, aircraft squadrons, SEALs, Special Purpose Marine Air-Ground Task Forces, Seabees, EOD Mobile Units and more throughout the globe.
